personality.description: This person tends to stick with familiar routines, prefers tried-and-true methods, and is usually cautious about unfamiliar ideas. They are flexible and spontaneous in daily behavior, but their disorganization can lead to missed details or late follow-through on commitments. When facing moral dilemmas, they usually begin with practical, conventional standards, then weigh personal convenience and the immediate impact on others before deciding; if something feels clearly unfair, they can still stand their ground. In group discussions, they speak in a balanced way, listening and cooperating at first, but becoming more direct and firm when they believe their own view needs to be defended.
